transcript: Guys, Nvidia ke founder ko jab media ne poocha ki aap black jacket kyu pehente ho leather wali? His reply was absolutely genius. He said that he loves to wear black. Black is the absence of choice. He does not have to think about it. He wakes up and that's one less choice to make. What should he wear? Saamne 10 jacket rakhe hain. He just picks one, wears it, and moves out without ever having to think, what should I wear? It's like a uniform so that he can direct all of his energy and his time and his efforts into doing the one thing that truly matters. Ask yourself, how much time do you end up spending just thinking kaun se kapde pehne chahiye every single day? And how much bandwidth is that taking away from your mind, which already has low attention span? The more choices your brain has to make, the harder it is going to be for it to focus on things that truly matter in your life, and that is the learning that you should have.
caption: Do you agree?
